Message to my partner:

> Before Task 1, the pre-flight scan found one conflict between tasks. It is recorded in `.sdd/7-currency-report/progress.md`.
>
> - **Task 2 produces** `fetch_rates(currency: str) -> dict[str, Decimal]`, the rates from one currency to every other.
> - **Task 4 consumes** `fetch_rates(currencies: list[str]) -> list[Rate]`, called once with every home currency.
> - **Why it matters:** the two signatures differ, and no task defines `Rate`. Task 3's `home_balance` takes `dict[str, Decimal]`, so Task 4's version would not feed it. The spec doesn't mention `fetch_rates`, so it can't settle this.
>
> **My recommendation:** keep Task 2's signature as written. Task 4 then calls it once per distinct home currency and passes each `dict[str, Decimal]` straight to `home_balance`. That needs no new `Rate` type and keeps amounts as `Decimal`. If you'd rather have the batch form, tell me, and I'll change Task 2 to the list-in, `list[Rate]`-out version and define `Rate` there. Task 3 would then need an adapter.
>
> I also need to know about git. This directory reports as not a git repository, but you described it as a fresh worktree on `feat/currency-report`. Task ranges and the final review need real commits. Is the worktree path different, or should I run `git init`?
>
> I'll start Task 1 as soon as you answer. After that I'll run all four tasks without stopping and then do the final review.
